title.zh: CFTC Registers Coinbase Clearing For Fully Collateralized Derivatives
title.en: CFTC Registers Coinbase Clearing For Fully Collateralized Derivatives

current_state.zh: The CFTC has registered Coinbase Clearing as a derivatives clearing organization for fully collateralized derivatives, expanding Coinbase's regulated US derivatives infrastructure.
